summary: OpenAI announced workspace agents in ChatGPT, described as Codex-powered agents that run in the cloud to automate workflows across tools for teams.

mechanisms.reason: The product lets cloud-based agents automate multi-step work across tools rather than humans operating software directly.
mechanisms.quote: Codex-powered agents that automate complex workflows, run in the cloud, and help teams scale work across tools securely.

mechanisms.reason: Cloud-run agents performing complex multi-tool workflows likely issue more inference calls per task than single-turn chat use.
mechanisms.quote: run in the cloud, and help teams scale work across tools securely
